split: 26 you can put on any attribute, plus 2 locked to the category you specialised in.
intro: How many Cap Breakers NBA 2K27 gives you and exactly where each one comes from. Five separate tracks grant them, and one of the five hands out a pair you cannot spend freely.

tracks.name: REP Track
tracks.blurb: The biggest single source. Ten ranks pay out, and Legend is the only one on the whole page that pays two at once.

tracks.name: Crew Track
tracks.blurb: Four Crew levels each grant one, spread from the middle of the track to the top of it.
tracks.note: Each of these needs 7 days of Crew membership before it can be claimed.

tracks.name: Build Specialization
tracks.blurb: One goal, two Cap Breakers, and the only ones on this page that come with a restriction attached.
tracks.note: Both are locked to the attribute category you specialised in, so they cannot be spent anywhere on the build.

tracks.name: Lifetime Challenges
tracks.blurb: Two goal milestones that count across the whole account rather than a single build.

tracks.name: Season Track
tracks.blurb: Level 40 of every season's track grants one, and 2K27 runs nine seasons. The second biggest source here, and the only one you cannot rush: it arrives a season at a time across the year.
